evidence.reason: The finding alleges that recheckAfter marks resolved:true when the targeted (id, signature) cluster was never present in the before snapshot. The tip code at src/ops/analyze/fix.ts:970-996 already implements the proposed guard: a `targeted` predicate, `observedBefore = targeted === undefined || before.report.clusters.some(targeted)`, `resolved = observedBefore && !report.clusters.some(targeted)`, and a `detail` explaining that the cluster was absent from the before-check. The history commit a5c44e9f7e7928c947dd73e8b98bba947477abee ('fix(review): require the targeted cluster before reporting resolved') is the fix now present at the tip.
